_README: Both lists MAY ONLY SHRINK. A new entry means a write route became reachable
without credentials; remove an entry by gating the route, not by editing this file.
executes_anonymously: the handler ran for a caller with no credentials (2xx).
inconclusive: neither 2xx nor 401/403 - the handler may have run and rejected the
input, so these are NOT a clean bill of health. Each carries a reason.
2026-11-14: seven entries removed by gating, not by editing -- /integrations/* (4), /agents/packs deploy+analyze, /billing/referral/redeem.

executes_anonymously.POST /api/contact: Free product surface; left public by decision in PR #248.
executes_anonymously.POST /auth/fido/authenticate/begin: A passkey authentication ceremony has no credential by definition (#248).
executes_anonymously.POST /auth/logout: Clears the caller's own session; nothing of anyone else's is reachable.
executes_anonymously.POST /business-community/commerce/webhoo: Known stub - logs and returns received:true, verifies no signature and changes no state. Recorded as 'noted, not fixed' in PR #248; do not mistake it for a verified webhook.
executes_anonymously.POST /kya/challenge/{did}: First-contact protocol: issues a nonce the caller can only answer with the DID's private key.
executes_anonymously.POST /marketplace/certificates/verify: Verifies a caller-supplied PEM and mutates nothing; POST only because it takes a body. Also in test_marketplace_route_auth._KNOWN_OPEN.
executes_anonymously.POST /mcp/: MCP transport endpoint. The JSON-RPC layer authorises per tool: free product tools are deliberately open, paid staff tools are gated (PR #698). Covered by test_mcp_paid_tools_not_anonymous.py.
executes_anonymously.POST /obsidian/scan: Free product surface; the Obsidian plugin's API key is optional, so gating breaks installs (#248).
executes_anonymously.POST /portal/auth/logout: Same: clears the caller's own portal session.
executes_anonymously.POST /scan/extensions: Same class as /scan/email - a stateless scanner over caller-supplied input. NOT covered by the #248 decision; whether to meter it is an open product call.
executes_anonymously.POST /sep/model-bundles/import: Authenticates in-body: import_bundle() verifies an HMAC over the bundle and answers {'status':'REJECTED','reason':'hmac_mismatch'} - with HTTP 200, which is why it shows up here. Its sibling /activate carries require_api_key since #248.
executes_anonymously.POST /threat/neutralizer/assess: Free product surface; left public by decision in PR #248.

inconclusive.POST /auth/login: Public by design; rejects before auth can apply.
inconclusive.POST /auth/saml/acs: SAML assertion consumer: the signed assertion is the credential, so no API key applies. 503 because SAML is unconfigured here.
inconclusive.POST /billing/webhook: Provider webhook; authenticity is the provider signature, not an API key.
inconclusive.POST /demo/filter: Free product surface (#248). The 500 is the probe environment (no model), not the handler.
inconclusive.POST /filter/file: Free product surface; multipart, so the JSON probe cannot reach the handler.
inconclusive.POST /kya/register: First-contact DID registration; rejected on DID format.
inconclusive.POST /kya/verify/{did}: First-contact protocol; answers a challenge, 404 for an unregistered DID.
inconclusive.POST /m2m-store/storefront/{slug}/order-: Anonymous buyer path by design (M5a); rejected on body validation here.
Buyer holds an order token (X-Order-Token); 404 because the probe's store does not exist.
inconclusive.POST /marketplace/register: Advertised M2M first-contact protocol - owner decision D-5; also in test_marketplace_route_auth._KNOWN_OPEN.
inconclusive.POST /portal/auth/forgot-password: Portal auth. The 500 is DATABASE_URL being unset in the probe environment - verified against production in the 2026-07-30 retraction, where these answer 401/422.
inconclusive.POST /portal/auth/login: Same - harness missing Postgres, not an open handler.
inconclusive.POST /security/pentest: Gated in-handler by _require_admin(x_admin_key) - a header check the dependency scan cannot see. Not open.
inconclusive.POST /slack/command: Fail-CLOSED since this PR: 503 without SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET, 403 on a bad signature.
